cohort: The study included 1030 women attending antenatal clinics after 20 weeks of gestation at King Abdulla University Hospital in Jordan.
finding: Awareness of the Post Placental Intra Uterine Contraceptive Device (PPIUCD) is low among women in Jordan, but antenatal introduction encourages a positive attitude towards it, with previous interval IUCD users and postgraduate women being more prone to a positive attitude.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between January 2020 and May 2021, among women after 20 weeks of gestation.
